superseded_reason: The board decided the pre-Step-6 cleaner-table approach and the old post-Step-6 pressure-check loop are different product designs, not arms of a fair comparison. Step 7 is rested by default now for simplicity and cost, while explicit deeper-review mode remains available.

product_intent.desired_direction: Move more useful reasoning pressure before Step 6 so the default Step 7 post-Step-6 pressure-check agents can become optional or manual-triggered if evidence supports it.
product_intent.non_claim: Step 7 is not obsolete by assertion.

comparison_arms.step6_table: current Step 6 material: four lanes plus V60 private enrichment
cleaner private table from dormant pre-Step-6 foundation and case-appropriate pressure atoms
comparison_arms.purpose: test whether Step 7 residual work shrinks without removing it

cleaner_table_operational_definition.shadow_portfolio_code_role: May record cached-deck custody and evidence, but it is not the whole treatment. The treatment is the Step 6 private table composition.
included_material: V60 private enrichment when active for the case
case-appropriate atomic pressure cards from the cleaning evidence surface
answer_delta / structural_delta ledger vocabulary for Step 6 custody
excluded_material: any change that skips Step 7 during this comparison

rubric: Label supports_optional_pressure_check_trial only when the cleaner-table arm preserves payload and Step 7 no longer adds meaningful corrective work for that record.
Label preserve_required_pressure_check when Step 7 still adds a material correction, independent mechanism, or safety-relevant divergence.
Label ambiguous_continue_research when the residual Step 7 work is mostly cognitive-independence nuance, reviewer evidence is split, or the record is hard to classify.

case_set.tests: whether upstream-carried counsel reversibility reduces Step 7 correction work
case_set.failure_read: Step 7 still finds the same counsel-boundary miss after cleaner table

case_set.tests: whether distributed atomic cards reduce preventable Step 7 corrections
case_set.failure_read: Step 7 still finds avoidable omissions across the PhD pressure atoms

case_set.tests: whether cleaner table avoids hiding V60 packet instability behind Step 7 removal
case_set.failure_read: cleaner table reduces visible pressure checks while V60 instability remains unexplained

case_set.tests: whether cleaner table preserves stand-down behavior on a sensitive case
case_set.failure_read: cleaner table creates performative extra pressure where anchor should remain sufficient

metrics.why: Primary signal: how often Step 7 still adds material after Step 6.
Tracks shifts Step 6 dismissed or minimized.
Tracks findings Step 6 treated as noise but Step 7 treated as material.
Tracks named mechanisms Step 7 connected that Step 6 did not.
Checks whether Step 6 considers pressure atoms discriminately.
Guards against cleaner-table narrowing that drops concrete payload.
Ensures Step 8c still has enough material if Step 7 work shrinks.
Measures cost upside without treating cost as correctness.
Captures human interpretation; code may nominate but humans decide.

outcomes.label: supports_optional_pressure_check_trial
outcomes.meaning: Cleaner-table arm preserves payload and materially reduces Step 7 correction work; proceed to a separate gated SKILL.md optional-pressure trial.

outcomes.label: preserve_required_pressure_check
outcomes.meaning: Step 7 still adds meaningful independent or corrective work; keep current skill flow.

outcomes.label: ambiguous_continue_research
outcomes.meaning: Results split by case role or reviewer interpretation; do not change SKILL.md.

supports_optional_pressure_check_trial.meaning: Cleaner table looks strong enough to justify a separate optional-pressure SKILL.md trial, not direct activation.

ambiguous_continue_research.meaning: Do not change SKILL.md; inspect the mixed cases.
